papers.title: Gray-box inference for structured Gaussian process models
papers.abstract: We develop an automated variational inference method for Bayesian structured prediction problems with Gaussian process (GP) priors and linear-chain likelihoods. Our approach does not need to know the details of the structured likelihood model and can scale up to a large number of observations. Furthermore, we show that the required expected likelihood term and its gradients in the variational objective (ELBO) can be estimated efficiently by using expectations over very low-dimensional Gaussian distributions. Optimization of the ELBO is fully parallelizable over sequences and amenable to stochastic optimization, which we use along with control variate techniques and state-of-the-art incremental optimization to make our framework useful in practice. Results on a set of natural language processing tasks show that our method can be as good as (and sometimes better than) hard-coded approaches including SVM-struct and CRFs, and overcomes the scalability limitations of previous inference algorithms based on sampling. Overall, this is a fundamental step to developing automated inference methods for Bayesian structured prediction.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文关注自然语言处理中的结构化预测，与FEA替代模型或生物力学设计无直接关联，但高斯过程方法可迁移至不确定性量化。
llm.why_not_core: No FEA, no surrogate modeling for expensive simulation, no constraint handling, no biomechanics or implant design context.

summary_zh.motivation: 为结构化高斯过程模型开发可扩展的自动推断方法
summary_zh.method: 使用低维高斯分布的期望高效估计ELBO，结合控制变量和随机优化
summary_zh.result: 在自然语言处理任务上与硬编码方法相当，且克服了采样方法的可扩展性限制

summary_en.motivation: Develop automated variational inference for structured Gaussian process models with linear-chain likelihoods to overcome scalability limitations of existing sampling-based algorithms.
summary_en.method: Estimates the expected likelihood and gradients in the ELBO using expectations over very low-dimensional Gaussian distributions, enabling fully parallelizable and stochastic optimization.
summary_en.result: Achieves comparable or better performance to hard-coded approaches like SVM-struct and CRFs on natural language processing tasks.
summary_en.validation: Evaluated on multiple NLP structured prediction tasks, comparing against deterministic baselines.

papers.title: Effects of tailored gradient interface on wear properties of WC/Inconel 718 composites using selective laser melting
papers.first_author_affiliation: College of Materials Science and Technology, Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics, Yudao Street 29, Nanjing 210016, PR China

corresponding_authors.name: Dongdong Gu
corresponding_authors.affiliation: College of Materials Science and Technology, Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics, Yudao Street 29, Nanjing 210016, PR China

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究WC/Inconel 718复合材料的磨损性能，不涉及生物医学植入物、多孔结构或应力遮挡。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on wear-resistant composites for industrial applications, with no porous structures, no biomedical context, no fatigue testing, and no osseointegration or surface roughness for implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究梯度界面设计对SLM制备WC/Inconel 718复合材料磨损性能的影响。
summary_zh.method: 利用选择性激光熔化制备具有梯度界面的复合材料，进行磨损测试。
summary_zh.result: 梯度界面显著提高了复合材料的耐磨性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过滑动磨损试验验证性能。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of a tailored gradient interface on the wear resistance of WC/Inconel 718 composites fabricated by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Gradient interfaces were designed and fabricated via selective laser melting, followed by wear testing.
summary_en.result: The gradient interface effectively enhanced wear resistance compared to abrupt interfaces.
summary_en.validation: Wear properties were validated through dry sliding wear tests.

papers.title: Influence of processing parameters on laser penetration depth and melting/re-melting densification during selective laser melting of aluminum alloy
papers.first_author_affiliation: College of Materials Science and Technology, Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics, Yudao Street 29, Nanjing, 210016, People’s Republic of China

corresponding_authors.name: Guanqun Yu
corresponding_authors.affiliation: College of Materials Science and Technology, Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics, Yudao Street 29, Nanjing, 210016, People’s Republic of China

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究铝合金选区激光熔化工艺参数对致密化的影响，与生物医学植入物多孔结构、应力遮挡或疲劳性能无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on aluminum alloy LPBF densification, not on porous biomedical implants, stress shielding, fatigue testing, or osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究铝合金SLM工艺参数对致密化的影响。
summary_zh.method: 通过调节激光功率、扫描速度等参数，分析熔化与重熔行为。
summary_zh.result: 揭示了工艺参数与穿透深度及致密度的关系。
summary_zh.validation: 通过密度测量和微观组织观察验证。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the influence of selective laser melting parameters on densification behavior of aluminum alloy.
summary_en.method: The study systematically varied laser power, scanning speed, and other parameters to analyze melting and re-melting dynamics.
summary_en.result: Correlations between processing parameters, laser penetration depth, and final density were established.
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation was conducted via density measurements and microstructural analysis.
